subject: Welcome to the Trondheim Bike Kitchen!
bodyText: Hi {name} and welcome to the Bike Kitchen! Your membership is valid until {expiry}. Feel free to join our Signal group to get in touch with other members. Any questions? Just reply to this email. Ride safe, and welcome to repair Wednesdays! We're open every Wednesday 17-20 at Bøker & bylab (Professor Brochs gate 2).
